user.title: CALinONE
user.description: Do you want to set up CALinONE? A webhook will be created that the CALinONE app pushes your shift schedule to. The app gets no access to anything else in Home Assistant.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.
abort.webhook_not_internet_accessible: Your Home Assistant instance needs to be accessible from the internet to receive webhook messages.

create_entry.default:
Copy this webhook URL into the CALinONE app (Settings → Home Assistant):

`{webhook_url}`

See {docs_url} for the full guide.
